name: All Even Sphere Dimensions at VC Dimension Three
statement: For every even $m\ge4$, there is a convex-realizable, dismantlable ample, finite convex-treelike class $C_m$ with $8m+8$ concepts, VC dimension three, coefficient dimension $d_m=8m+\binom m2$, and $\mathcal A(C_m)\cong S^{m-2}\times\mathbb R^{d_m-m+2}$. Its integral homology has Betti polynomial $1+z^{m-2}$.
proof: Apply the oriented bipartite construction to a consistently directed even cycle. Zero-sum edge increments reduce the directed domain to $(H_m\setminus\{0\})\times\Delta_{m-1}^{\circ}$ times Euclidean factors, and polar coordinates produce the sphere.
